purpose: Express observable reference collection semantics without selecting a programming-language container.

required.statement: The collection kind is one of the eight closed kinds.
Membership, minimum and maximum cardinality, ordering, duplicates, key contract, and value contract are explicit.

forbidden.statement: A sequence must not be substituted for a set, multiset, or ordered set when observable semantics differ.
An implementation container must not create ordering or duplicate guarantees absent from the package.

deferred.statement: Container type, layout, hashing, comparison, and allocation strategy are implementation-defined.

global_invariants.statement: A conforming representation preserves every collection semantic declared by the consuming package.

notes: This shared contract defines the vocabulary; consuming packages select concrete semantics.
